policy: Preserve extension failures; none affect protected protocol history.

attempts.finding: Infinite risk for no-eligible-method abstentions caused SVD failure.
attempts.resolution: Exclude infinite scores only from slope/correlation; retain them as worst rank.

attempts.finding: Object-typed covered_truth produced invalid bitwise complement and negative preliminary AURC.
attempts.resolution: Explicit Boolean cast; regenerated all derived results.
Exclude only undefined rows from the absolute-error target.

attempts.finding: GeoX rejects min_r2 values 0 and below despite generic between-zero-and-one validation text.
attempts.resolution: Use valid 0.01 in the new operations adapter.

attempts.finding: Generic recursive serialization of Design caused RecursionError after successful designs.
attempts.resolution: Capture official design IDs, treatment/control sets, and metric rows explicitly.

attempts.finding: GeoX requires float64 conversions while GeoLift CSV stores integer counts.
S13 missingness caused donor-weight SVD failure and mixed unit identifiers failed Arrow conversion.
attempts.resolution: Use the benchmark's pre-period median handling and canonical string identifiers.

attempts.finding: First extension attempt encoded zero delivered dose as zero structural dose-response truth.
attempts.resolution: Archived attempt v1; later revisions define structural per-dose truth and mark zero-dose estimation unidentified.

attempts.finding: Revision 2 allowed heterogeneous propensity below one in the nominal 100% regime.
attempts.resolution: Archived attempt v2; revision 3 reserves exact zero/full endpoints and applies heterogeneity only to partial-compliance regimes.

attempts.finding: The first integration mapped a passing GeoX quality check to design_available without executing a design for that perturbed cell.
attempts.resolution: Corrected before final closure by running official compare_designs after every quality check and retaining design metrics or the complete failure reason separately.
